title: Orchestrator persisted state — queue, artifacts, checkpoints (MAT-4); sessions + fluency (MAT-10); budgets (MAT-98)

schema_version.description: Document format version. 1.1.0 adds optional MAT-10 `orchestrator_session` and checkpoint `fluency`. 1.2.0 adds optional MAT-98 per-session / per-task `token_budget` and `cost_budget` (and optional usage counters). Writers omitting newer fields may stay on an earlier version.

token_budget.description: Maximum cumulative tokens (input + output) allowed before the run must halt with budget_exceeded.

cost_budget.description: Maximum cumulative cost (currency units configured by the orchestrator) allowed before the run must halt with budget_exceeded.

tokens_used.description: Cumulative tokens consumed so far against the matching token_budget.

cost_used.description: Cumulative cost consumed so far against the matching cost_budget.

orchestrator_session.description: MAT-10: optional handle for the primary orchestrator session (e.g. main Claude Code) that owns planning, routing, and review. Distinct from MAT-2 worker `checkpoints.items[].session`. MAT-98: optional session-level token/cost budgets.

session_id.description: Opaque orchestrator session id (tool-defined; not an absolute path).

repo_profile_link.description: Optional link to MAT-9 `identity.id` for the same repo; paths in this document are repo-relative from repo root (same rules as MAT-9). Prefer storing artifacts and checkpoints under `repo.path_overrides.artifacts_dir` / `agent_state_dir` when those overrides exist.

identity_id.description: Matches MAT-9 `identity.id` for the portable repo profile.

repo_relative_path.description: Path relative to repo root; no leading slash, no URL scheme, no parent traversal at start (aligned with MAT-9 `repo_relative_path`).

items.description: Ordered work queue; orchestrator defines ordering policy.

id.description: Stable id for this queue entry (opaque to executors).

status.description: Lifecycle status for orchestration and dashboards. `budget_exceeded` (MAT-98) is a terminal halt when session or task token/cost budget is exhausted.

title.description: Human-readable label for prompts and UI.

work_item.description: Optional binding to an external work item (opaque ids; adapter aligns with MAT-9 `work_item_source.adapter`).

external_id.description: Opaque id in the external system (issue key, Linear id, etc.).

id.description: Unique id for this artifact row (uuid recommended).

kind.description: Coarse classifier for routing and retention policy.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the artifact bytes on disk. Typically under MAT-9 `repo.path_overrides.artifacts_dir` when set.
Repo-relative path to checkpoint payload (graph snapshot, JSON blob, etc.). Typically under MAT-9 `repo.path_overrides.agent_state_dir` when set.

label.description: Optional human label (e.g. after successful tool batch).

session.description: Optional link to MAT-2 code-exec session when this checkpoint ties to a worker session.

checkpoint_fluency.description: MAT-10: optional metadata tying this checkpoint to fluency / introspection tooling. High-signal planning and review should run in the main orchestrator session when scores matter.

capture_phase.description: Orchestrator phase associated with this checkpoint for fluency correlation.

insights_surface.description: Optional entrypoint label (e.g. /ai-fluency-insights) for documentation alignment; not a URL.

correlation_id.description: Optional second trace id for correlating with introspection exports; use `queue.items[].correlation_id` for work-item tracing.

transitions.description: Append-only log of significant queue/session state transitions (e.g. MAT-98 budget_exceeded).

queue_item_id.description: Queue item id when the transition applies to a task.

scope.description: Whether the transition was triggered by session or task budget/policy.
